k-apocrycoin.title: Apocrycoin GTA VI in-game memecoin
k-apocrycoin.sourceSays: Posts say GTA VI footage names two in-game memecoins, DacityCoin and Apocrycoin, and that traders are launching Apocrycoin and ticker-guess coins; the posts are unverified claims.
k-apocrycoin.reason: Posts of Nov 18 16:09-18:09 UTC describe an Apocrycoin reference in GTA VI and debate its ticker; the pump.fun coins opened 0.8-2.8h ago, after the reference surfaced.

k-vice.title: GTA VI Vice City coins
k-vice.sourceSays: Posts say a wave of Vice-named coins is launching ahead of GTA VI's release; an account says GTA shows a VCI ticker, and ripr counted 1,230 Vice coins. Claims are unverified.
k-vice.reason: Posts of Nov 14 and Nov 18 describe Vice-named coins tied to the GTA VI release; the newer VICE 6 and Vice6 pools opened 2.5-3.1h ago, though the oldest VTC pool predates this.
